snippet.title: Witch Schools: Love Potions | ON Steam Game
snippet.description:
A jigsaw puzzle based on the well-known “tag” and “Match 3". Move objects, collect their rows and don't forget to keep track of the number of remaining moves! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2093250/Witch_Schools_Love_Potions/
